hints.title: Parity State Transitions
hints.text: Subsequences can be partitioned based on whether their running sum is even or odd.

hints.title: Odd Number Effect
hints.text: Adding an odd number toggles previous even sums to odd sums and previous odd sums to even sums, while also forming a new singleton odd subsequence.

hints.title: Even Number Effect
hints.text: Adding an even number preserves parities while doubling both existing counts and creating a new singleton even subsequence.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^n subsequences times out exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra memory using two tracking registers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains running parity counts with modulo arithmetic.
